thread:
Lina (BizOps): short Q after the town hall: are we experimenting with pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated, or keeping price parity?
Ava (CEO): we will run conservative experiments. pricing should reflect cost+value: Hosted for velocity, Dedicated for predictability. no sudden list price changes for existing customers.
Jordan (Sales): from AE calls: buyers want predictable unit economics and a way to estimate monthly costs for Dedicated. can we provide a simple cost calculator?
Sam (VP Product): yes. product will ship a cost-estimator widget for the console and an AE spreadsheet template. Lina -> can ops surface what inputs you need?
Lina (BizOps): will draft the inputs: model family, token mix, qps profile, caching rate, and expected retention for KV cache.
Priya (Head of Research): small ask: pricing experiments should be tied to measurable signals: conversion to Dedicated, churn, and request mix changes.
Hector (Open Source): question on messaging: how do we talk about open models and OSS runtimes? we don't want to sound adversarial.
Ava (CEO): be collaborative. message: "We make open models performant and dependable in production." avoid negative comparisons. cite measurable differentiators.
Kai (Eng): technical note: bundling runtime optimizations with our deployment (e.g., kernel patches) can be sensitive. legal and compliance need to sign off on redistribution.
Sam (VP Product): noted. product will coordinate with Legal for any redistributable artifacts and with Eng for clear install docs.
Jordan (Sales): partners ask about reseller margins and co-sell. any direction?
Ava (CEO): channel strategy: pilot selective partnerships this quarter. focus on partners that accelerate regulated verticals (fin/health). margins negotiable case-by-case.
Priya (Head of Research): competitor context: we've seen aggressive "free tier" plays from infra competitors. we should track signal but not match giveaways. prioritise value-first offers.
Hector (Open Source): can we contribute back some benchmark harnesses to OSS repos? it helps transparency and trust.
Ava (CEO): yes where safe. open parts of the harness and keep infra secrets internal. Sam & Hector pair to define boundary.
Lina (BizOps): timeline ask: can we get a short playbook for AEs on pricing experiments & partner pilot criteria in 10 business days?
Sam (VP Product): will do. Sam -> Lina owns the doc, Jordan will review.
calendar-bot: (system) Reminder: pricing-experiment sync scheduled in 5 days -> calendar invite updated.
Ava (CEO): thanks. keep the experiments measured and customer-forward. focus on signals that change buying behavior. :sparkles:
